sentences.text: BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOUMITRA SAIKIA  ORDER 09.12.2024 Heard Mr. A.C. Sharma, leaned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. N. Brahma, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr. C. Baruah, learned Standing Counsel, NHIDCL for the respondent nos. 1 to 4 and Mr. J. Handique, learned Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent nos. 5 & 6.

The petitioner is the owner of a plot of land measuring 1 Bigha 2 Katha 5 Lechas covered by Dag No.28 under Patta No.379 at Krishnai Town, Mouza- Matia, Revenue Circle-Matia in Goalpara district, Assam.
On the said land he has a shop as well as his house.

It is the grievance of the petitioner that the said Page No.# 3/4 land was acquired by the respondent authorities for construction and widening of the National Highway, however, the petitioner has not yet been received the adequate compensation in respect of the proposed construction sought to be carried out by the National Highway.

sentences.text: 2 Mr. C. Baruah, learned Standing Counsel for the NHIDCL submits that under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956 in respect of compensation and distribution thereof is the competent Authority for land acquisition who is normally an Officer under the District Commissioner.
However, the said official has not been arrayed as a party respondent.
The status of the claim of the petitioner for grant of adequate compensation for the land to be acquired will be available before the said authority appointed for the said district.
Mr. J Handique, learned Government Advocate, Assam, submits that the appropriate authority is the Competent Authority of the Land Acquisition (CALA).
Under such circumstances, this Court is of the view that the CALA should be arrayed as a party respondent.

Accordingly, in view of the oral submissions made by the learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner,
the Competent Authority of the Land Acquisition (CALA), District Goalpara is arrayed as the respondent no.7. Learned counsel for the petitioner on record shall file amended cause-title before the Registry within a period of 1 (one) week from today showing the name of the newly arrayed respondent the Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA), district Goalpara as the respondent no.7.

Since Mr. J Handique, learned Government Advocate, Assam is appearing for the respondent nos. 5 & 6, he will also represent the newly arrayed Page No.# 4/4 respondent no.7, namely, the Competent Authority of the Land Acquisition (CALA), District Goalpara.
Let the respondents obtain their required instructions in the matter.
Adequate extra copies of the petition shall be served to the respective learned counsel for the respondents within a period of 1 (one) week from today.
Let the matter be listed on 06.01.2025.
